speaker: interviewer
text: Thanks for coming in today. Could you start by telling me where you studied and what you have done since?

speaker: candidate
text: Sure. I did a degree in industrial engineering at Lakeside Polytechnic, then spent a summer at a logistics firm and a year at a small software consultancy.

speaker: interviewer
text: What kind of work did you do at the consultancy?

speaker: candidate
text: Mostly data cleanup and some client calls. I helped a retail client move their stock records into a new system.

speaker: interviewer
text: Where do you see your career going over the next several years?

speaker: candidate
text: I'd like to end up leading operations projects, ideally somewhere that mixes analysis with working directly with people.

speaker: interviewer
text: Tell me about a hard problem you had to solve.

speaker: candidate
text: The stock migration kept failing overnight. I traced it to duplicate product codes, wrote a script to flag them, and we reran it.

speaker: candidate
text: It worked, I think. Things were better afterwards.

speaker: interviewer
text: Have you ever led a team?

speaker: candidate
text: Not formally. I sometimes coordinated the two interns on the migration.
